newsitem.title: USA: Price Comms sells Florida region to Wireless One.
newsitem.headline: Price Comms sells Florida region to Wireless One.

text.p: Price Communications Corp said Monday it has reached an agreement to sell the Fort Myers, Florida cellular region of Palmer Wireless Inc for $168 million to Wireless One Network LP.

Price, which recently announced its Price Communications Cellular Corp subsidiary will buy Palmer Wireless Inc for $880 million, said Wireless One owns the three regions surrounding Fort Myers. Price said the Fort Myers region represents about 10 percent of the population purchased from Palmer.
Price also said the $168 million purchase price will result in a profit for the company, and willl "substantially de-leverage" its financing for the Palmer deal.
The company said the Palmer Wireless headquarter will remain in Fort Myers.
Both the Palmer agreement and the subsequent sale of Fort Myers are pending FCC approval.
